cases.reasoning: Both are self-contained, measured board briefings with complete figures, cohort limitations, cost and staffing scope, and mandatory safety approval. A integrates the evidence limits with the results and ends on whether better evidence warrants the cost; B separates results from interpretation and reinforces uncertainty. Neither organizational choice creates a material advantage for this director.

scoring_notes: Scores use the supplied 1–5 writing dimensions plus reader relevance. Edit restraint is scored for actual revision/proofreading tasks 207, 403 and 406, and omitted for fresh briefing/email drafting.
No score is reduced for stylistic variation alone. Minor defects in 403 affect fluency/selectivity without making the copy unusable.
Word counts use whitespace-separated words; all outputs are comfortably inside their requested intervals. Exact paragraph preservation in 406 ignores only the file’s terminal newline.

eval_feedback.reason: The assertions enforce factual restraint and length but do not directly test whether the copy is compelling or reads naturally. Both pass despite A’s repeated replacement explanation and awkward “the LED module can change when it needs to.” The qualitative writing dimensions are needed to catch that difference.

limitations: These are single-sample blind editorial comparisons of the six assigned packets. No authorship labels, actor reports, prior results, skill instructions or external claims were consulted.
